description: Source code for a graphics benchmarking sample comparing TRIANGLE_FAN and TRIANGLES rendering methods in OpenGL ES 2.0, including buffer creation, rendering loop, and timing metrics.

classes.name: TriangleFanBenchSample
classes.description: A class that benchmarks rendering performance of triangle fans versus triangles in OpenGL ES 2.0.

methods.name: createVertexBuffers
methods.description: Creates vertex buffer objects for triangle fan and triangle data, populating buffers with vertex positions.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the OpenGL program, sets clear color, creates buffers, and initializes timing variables.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Outputs total rendering times and deletes the shader program.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Performs rendering of multiple squares using both TRIANGLE_FAN and TRIANGLES, timing each method.
